name: Spooltape
source:
While exploring analog horror for his next documentary, a filmmaker buys a mysterious VHS linked to a vanished cult. Planning to record his reaction, he soon realizes the tape isn’t what it seems.

[From [url=https://rocrac.itch.io/spooltape]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一位电影制片人在为下一部纪录片探索模拟恐怖时，购买了一部与已消失的邪教有关的神秘录像带。当他打算记录下自己的反应时，他很快意识到录像带并不像看上去的那样。

[来自[url=https://rocrac.itch.io/spooltape]Itch.io[/url]]
